scope: Bounded read-only static review of Probe15 ended-verification producer, contract, runner and Root-only source sealer. No actual run adjudication.

derivationReview.method: Read source bytes and apply the declared literal replacements in memory, then reverse in the opposite order. No target module imported or executed.

identityReview.pidSource: Only the two small public process metadata JSON files were read; reviewer did not query or operate live processes.

behaviorReview: Full success requires original stage-2/stage-10/soak 300/300/360 configuration, actual measuredSeconds >= configured, and 5/5/6 contiguous real windows each >=60 seconds; no shorter-profile promotion.

Whole-phase activity/native-rate checks use measuredSeconds; minute checks use actual window.seconds. Original policy is deep-equal and original 18 launch/12 positive, movement, correction, timeout and dual-endpoint receipt gates are not lowered.

Failed or partial reports retain their original verdict. Complete three-stage/16-window shape is success-only; partial boundaries and already-recorded windows are replayed without fabricating missing stages.

HP uses the exact preserved ten-status proof contract. Zero events means verifiedEventsChecked=0, successProofChecked=false and noVerifiedDoseObserved=true; it does not prove any actual dose or healing.
Wire source/terminal/counters/uninstall and strictly increasing sequence are checked separately. Truncation/diagnostic completeness never creates gameplay ACK, damage credit or capacity acceptance.

Root cleanup requires schema1, the actual run and fixed gateway/monitor PIDs, absent processes/free ports, empty arrays, readOnlyIndependentCheck=true and capacityAccepted=false; proof must exist before actual verification.

Type/kind/status/actor strings and dictionary cardinality, actor maps, windows and phase records retain the inherited bounded replay limits. Probe memory output does not certify the formal two-hour memory-slope contract.
limitations: The stream reader trusts the existing frozen-producer/raw SHA and byte manifest. readline aggregates a line before the subsequent 64MiB line check; this review does not claim an adversarial overlong-line memory bound.

No actual Probe15 final report, complete raw, monitor, public collection or root cleanup proof was consumed by this review. This receipt cannot replace the ended-only verifier result or a fresh formal capacity run.
The advertised 5 syntax checks are producer metadata, not fresh tests executed by this reviewer. No extra benchmark, product test or service was started.
